Adapted from the [source report](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FuVfgN-JbE4pBMSoXS6X5yTnXet_lDQ91Y4VgFDG59U/edit), checked September 30, 2026. The pages describe available evidence, not completed model calibration or validation.

## Overview

The MAGiC pipeline is used to generate inventory and projection estimates of SOC stocks and GHG emissions from California croplands.

The calibration and validation dataset combines two complementary bodies of evidence that constrain different quantities.

**Site-level data** provides SOC stocks and greenhouse gas fluxes from six California sites. It supports site-specific assessment of model magnitudes, with measurement support and temporal coverage matched explicitly.

**Synthesis evidence** is a set of values from statistical synthesis of published literature on the impacts of sustainable farming practices on SOC and GHG balance. It answers a question about response: when a practice changes, does the model respond in a direction and rough magnitude that is consistent with available evidence.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Neither of these datasets is sufficient. The limited site-level dataset is insufficient for calibration because it is easy to overfit the model to specific sites while missing the big picture changes.
:::

Synthesis datasets may include some of the site observations. Check source overlap before treating the two evidence streams as statistically independent.

### Key points

| Key point | Detail |
| :--------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Soil carbon and gas flux are measured at different sites.** | Of the six sites, two include SOC stock measurements (Russell Ranch and Salinas), four provide gas exchange (Modesto and the three towers), and no site carries both. Any claim spanning both is an extrapolation, not a validated result. |
| **Practice contrasts exist at three sites.** SOC contrasts are concentrated at two annual-crop sites; Modesto adds a compost–control N2O contrast. | There is no measured practice contrast anywhere in the Delta, and none for rice. |
| **Six of the 18 statewide cells have likelihood-eligible targets**, where a cell is one practice paired with one outcome. | They are cover crops, non-crop carbon and reduced tillage on soil carbon, reduced tillage on N~2~O, fertilisation on N~2~O, and rice drying on CH~4~. Two more have no published spread and are used to check the direction of the model response ([B5](statewide-evidence.qmd#b5-where-the-spread-is-an-expert-informed-prior)). |
| **Two caveats apply to the targets.** | [Salinas 2003 and 2004](site-level-data.qmd#a5-the-soil-carbon-record) are excluded as establishment effects, and [US-Bi2](site-level-data.qmd#a6-the-flux-record) is a much larger net carbon source than its neighbour, a magnitude to confirm with the site team. Both are described in place. |
| **Coverage and usability are not the same thing.** | An empty cell indicates that no useable target was identified in the sources reviewed. |
